about: Fixture for exploring the evaluation screen (28-29 Oct).

cases.prompt: Create an RFP + RFQ event from an existing PR with 1 line item, invite 2 vendors and publish it. One vendor logs into the vendor portal, answers the technical sheet and quotes 95; for the other vendor the buyer enters a surrogate technical response and a surrogate bid of 100. Then end the bidding.
cases.must: PR → RFP+RFQ, published, a portal and a surrogate response on each stage, bidding ended.
